Sandbox_LCO_ChanceToFall_tooltip: <RGB:0,1,0>Probability that the cap will fall off your head. Lower value = less chance.
Sandbox_LCO_DropFLC_tooltip: <RGB:0,1,0>Chance of finding a Legendary Flashlight in the world, higher value = higher probability.
Sandbox_LCO_DropLCC: Chance of finding Common Legendary Cap
Sandbox_LCO_DropLCC_tooltip: <RGB:0,1,0>Chance of finding a Legendary Cap in common locations (bedroom, wardrobe). Higher value = higher probability.
Sandbox_LCO_DropLCR: Chance of finding Rare Legendary Cap
Sandbox_LCO_DropLCR_tooltip: <RGB:0,1,0>Chance of finding a Legendary Cap in rare locations (police, army, fire). Higher value = higher probability.
Sandbox_LCO_DropMLC: Chance of finding Legendary Cap Magazine
Sandbox_LCO_DropMLC_tooltip: <RGB:0,1,0>Chance of finding a magazine that teaches how to craft the Legendary Cap, higher value = higher probability.
Sandbox_LCO_WindResistance_tooltip: <RGB:0,1,0>How well the cap protects against wind (0-1).
description: Find legendary caps in the world. You can also craft them yourself after finding the recipe in magazines.
